draft_en.subject: Alongside the Utepo PoE switches in your Dahua / Milesight kits - neutral-brand numbers
draft_en.body:
Hi Pavel,

Over the past months you had a few product mails from us - most recently "Managed PoE Switches" on 28 September 2026 - and there was no reason to answer a mass mail. This one is specific.

Alongside the Utepo PoE switches you supply with Dahua and Milesight kits, neutral-brand units at distributor price, EXW, MOQ 1, 15-day validity, CE/RoHS/UKCA: 8 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2+ managed, Marvell-based - model STC-28DGGPM - $80.7 USD; budget 8 x PoE+ + 2 x Gigabit unmanaged - STC-028GP - $25.1; 16 x Gigabit PoE+ + 2 x SFP, L2 managed - STC-2216GPM - $141.7.

One question: which port count do your trade customers buy most - 8 or 16?

Best regards,
Alan
Saga Telecom - sagatele.com
